ee:variables.ee:set-variable:
%dw 2.0 output application/java
var fileName = (attributes.fileName default "") as String
var stagingDirectory = (vars.validStagingDirectory default "") as String
--- stagingDirectory ++ "/" ++ fileName

%dw 2.0 output application/java
var fileName = (attributes.fileName default "") as String
--- fileName replace /\.part$/ with ""

%dw 2.0 output application/java
var stagedName = (attributes.fileName default "") as String
var finalName = stagedName replace /\.part$/ with ""
var remoteDirectory = (vars.targetDirectory default "outbound") as String
--- remoteDirectory ++ "/." ++ finalName ++ ".part"

logger.doc:name: Log Valid File Publication
logger.message: #[output application/json --- { event: "VALID_STORE_FILE_PUBLISHED", finalFileName: vars.finalFileName, remoteFinalFile: vars.targetDirectory ++ "/" ++ vars.finalFileName }]

ee:variables.ee:set-variable:
%dw 2.0 output application/java
var fileName = (attributes.fileName default "") as String
var stagingDirectory = (vars.rejectedStagingDirectory default "") as String
--- stagingDirectory ++ "/" ++ fileName

%dw 2.0 output application/java
var fileName = (attributes.fileName default "") as String
--- fileName replace /\.part$/ with ""

%dw 2.0 output application/java
var stagedName = (attributes.fileName default "") as String
var finalName = stagedName replace /\.part$/ with ""
var remoteDirectory = (vars.rejectedTargetDirectory default "rejected") as String
--- remoteDirectory ++ "/." ++ finalName ++ ".part"

logger.doc:name: Log Rejected File Publication
logger.message: #[output application/json --- { event: "REJECTED_FILE_PUBLISHED", finalFileName: vars.finalRejectFileName, remoteFinalFile: vars.rejectedTargetDirectory ++ "/" ++ vars.finalRejectFileName }]

logger.doc:name: Log Publication Completion
logger.message: #[output application/json --- { event: "INVENTORY_OUTPUT_PUBLICATION_COMPLETED", targetDirectory: vars.targetDirectory, rejectedTargetDirectory: vars.rejectedTargetDirectory, validFilesFound: sizeOf(vars.stagedValidFiles default []), rejectedFilesFound: sizeOf(vars.stagedRejectedFiles default []) }]
